description: Networks of nodes + flows — warehouses, hubs, ports, routes, capacities. Bottleneck emergence, throughput-vs-utilization (Little's Law), buffer dynamics, cascade delays, route imbalance.

expected_relationships.rationale: Upstream delays propagate to downstream nodes

characteristic_patterns.name: Bottleneck emergence
characteristic_patterns.signature: Single edge utilization saturates while other edges have headroom

characteristic_patterns.name: Throughput saturation
characteristic_patterns.signature: Throughput-vs-utilization curve flattens above critical point

characteristic_patterns.name: Buffer depletion
characteristic_patterns.signature: Monotonic decrease in buffer level toward zero
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: buffer < 20% of historical baseline AND trend < 0

characteristic_patterns.name: Cascade delay
characteristic_patterns.signature: Delay at upstream node propagates downstream with lag

characteristic_patterns.name: Route imbalance
characteristic_patterns.signature: Alternative routes used asymmetrically beyond expected variance

characteristic_patterns.name: Flow collapse
characteristic_patterns.signature: Step decrease in throughput on a previously stable edge
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: PELT change-point on flow with negative magnitude > 30%

action_library.label: Identify bottleneck
action_library.description: Surface the saturated edge or node with the highest impact on overall throughput. Rank by Δ throughput-if-relieved.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Identified bottlenecks usually account for 60-80% of system-wide delay; relieving the top-ranked one yields ~40% throughput gain in similar networks.
falsification: throughput unchanged after relieving identified bottleneck
assumptions: network topology stable over analysis window

action_library.label: Recommend reroute
action_library.description: Propose flow redistribution to alternate edges based on capacity headroom and historical service quality.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Reroute recommendations relieve target edge utilization by 15-30% in deployments with multi-route topology.
falsification: target utilization unchanged or increased after reroute

action_library.label: Recommend capacity rebalance
action_library.description: Surface candidates for capacity expansion or reallocation given throughput-saturation evidence.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Capacity decisions are slow and irreversible; ~50% of saturation findings warrant expansion vs reallocation.

action_library.label: Recommend buffer adjustment
action_library.description: Surface buffers at risk of depletion and propose target levels with lead-time-aware safety stock.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Buffer-target adjustments avert ~70% of stockout incidents in similar systems.

action_library.label: Predict cascade impact
action_library.description: Given a delay at node X, project propagation to downstream nodes using cross-correlation lags.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Cross-correlation projections capture ~60% of variance in downstream delay magnitude.
falsification: downstream delay falls outside 95% projection CI
